color.note: Scout dashboard branch (.sh scope inside WordPress admin). Light only: WordPress's own screen parts have no dark mode.

tokens.name: sh-bg
tokens.usage: Page canvas behind a Scout screen when one is painted. WordPress's own #f0f0f1 shows around it.

tokens.name: sh-surface
tokens.usage: Boxes, cards, tables, inputs.

tokens.name: sh-surface-2
tokens.usage: Insets, hover fills, chips, the meter track. Text on it uses sh-text-2 or darker.

tokens.name: sh-text
tokens.usage: Headings and body text.

tokens.name: sh-text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: ledes, summaries, chip labels.

tokens.name: sh-text-3
tokens.usage: Notes, labels, table heads. Darker than the brand #86868B so 11 to 13px text passes AA on white. Never on sh-surface-2.

tokens.name: sh-border
tokens.usage: Hairlines and box borders.

tokens.name: sh-border-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders.

tokens.name: sh-accent
tokens.usage: Cerulean spark with NO text on it: the bolt, dots, focus borders, the meter, active underlines, checkbox fill.

tokens.name: sh-accent-fill
tokens.usage: Cerulean behind white text: primary buttons, the active nav group, the active tab, pager current. 4.69:1.

tokens.name: sh-accent-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of anything on sh-accent-fill.

tokens.name: sh-accent-ink
tokens.usage: Old name, kept so older plugin copies keep working. Same as sh-accent-fill-hover.

tokens.name: sh-accent-text
tokens.usage: Cerulean as text: links, eyebrows, quiet buttons.

tokens.name: sh-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on sh-accent-fill.

tokens.name: sh-glow
tokens.usage: Soft cerulean tint: focus ring, an update tag, a quiet button hover.

tokens.name: sh-accent-line
tokens.usage: Cerulean border: outline buttons, a card that is on, hover borders.

tokens.name: sh-good
tokens.usage: Good status as text (On, Done, Up to date). Dark enough to pass AA on its own tint.

tokens.name: sh-good-mark
tokens.usage: Good status as a shape: dots, the Bonus diamond.

tokens.name: sh-good-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind good status text.

tokens.name: sh-warn
tokens.usage: Needs a look, as text.

tokens.name: sh-warn-mark
tokens.usage: Needs a look, as a shape. Never put text on it.

tokens.name: sh-warn-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind warn status text.

tokens.name: sh-bad
tokens.usage: Broken or risky, as text. Delete links.

tokens.name: sh-bad-mark
tokens.usage: Broken, as a shape.

tokens.name: sh-bad-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind bad status text.

tokens.name: sh-kind-core
tokens.usage: Core features: the bolt.

tokens.name: sh-kind-bonus
tokens.usage: Bonus features: the green diamond.

tokens.name: sh-kind-plus
tokens.usage: Plus modules: the purple plus sign and the + Plus tag.

tokens.name: sh-kind-recon
tokens.usage: Recon: the amber bar chart.

tokens.name: sh-data-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (cerulean). Use in order, charts and categories only.

tokens.name: sh-data-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 (teal). Use in order, charts and categories only.

tokens.name: sh-data-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 (coral). Use in order, charts and categories only.

tokens.name: sh-data-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4 (amber). Use in order, charts and categories only.

tokens.name: sh-data-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5 (violet). Use in order, charts and categories only.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Oxygen-Sans, Ubuntu, Cantarell, "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per screen, the h1. 26px on phones.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: A section heading inside a screen.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: The title of a card in a grid.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Your hours show on Google, your site and the chat.
styles.usage: The one sentence under the page title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pick the days you are closed.
styles.usage: Everything else. 18px with Larger text on.

styles.name: note
styles.usage: Help text under a field, footers.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase, sh-accent-text, above a page or section title.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase, sh-text-3. Table heads, small labels.

spacing.note: 4px steps. Use flex or grid gap, not margins between siblings.

radius.note: Scout Core radii, as on the approved dashboard canvas.

tokens.name: sh-r-chip
tokens.usage: Chips, code, inputs inside a row.

tokens.name: sh-r-control
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, square buttons, notices.

tokens.name: sh-r-card
tokens.usage: Boxes, cards, tables, big tabs. Same as Scout Core cards.

tokens.name: sh-r-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, status pills, the nav group bar.

shadow.note: Very soft. Only on hover and the active item.

tokens.name: sh-shadow-hover
tokens.usage: A card or link card on hover.

tokens.name: sh-shadow-active
tokens.usage: The active big tab.

tokens.name: sh-shadow-nav
tokens.usage: The active nav group.

size.note: Type sizes as CSS variables, matching the type styles. Same scale as the approved dashboard canvas (Recon branch): 16px body, never smaller than 12px.

layout.note: Screen width and the no-four-across rule.

tokens.name: sh-max
tokens.usage: Widest a Scout screen gets.

tokens.name: sh-col-min
tokens.usage: Smallest column in a card grid. At 1180px that allows three across at most.

tokens.name: sh-tap
tokens.usage: Smallest height for a button, input or menu link (the dashboard map rule).

tokens.name: sh-pad
tokens.usage: Inside a box or card.

motion.note: Color and shadow fades only. Larger text and less motion turn it off.

tokens.name: sh-dur
tokens.usage: Hover fades.

tokens.name: sh-ease
tokens.usage: The only easing, from the Recon branch: quick start, soft landing.
